name: search_flights
description: Search for available flights between two cities on a given date
returns: List of available flights with price, duration, airline, stops, departure/arrival times

name: search_hotels
description: Search for available hotels in a specified city or area

location.description: City or area to search for hotels

max_price_per_night.description: Maximum price per night in USD

returns: List of available hotels with name, rating, price per night, amenities, and location details

name: book_flight
description: Book a specific flight for one or more passengers

flight_id.description: Unique identifier of the flight to book

passengers.description: List of passenger objects with name, date_of_birth, passport_number

payment_method_id.description: ID of the payment method to use

returns: Booking confirmation with booking_id, itinerary details, total price, and e-ticket numbers

name: book_hotel
description: Book a hotel room for specified dates

payment_method_id.description: ID of the payment method to use

special_requests.description: Any special requests (e.g., late check-in, extra pillows)

returns: Booking confirmation with reservation_id, hotel details, room details, total cost

name: cancel_booking
description: Cancel an existing travel booking (flight or hotel)

booking_id.description: Unique identifier of the booking to cancel

returns: Cancellation confirmation with refund amount and refund timeline

name: get_booking_details
description: Retrieve details of an existing booking by its ID
returns: Full booking details including status, itinerary, passengers, payment info, and cancellation policy

name: search_car_rentals
description: Search for available rental cars at a specific location

pickup_location.description: City or airport code for car pickup

dropoff_location.description: Different return location if one-way rental

returns: List of available rental cars with type, price per day, company, and included features

name: book_car_rental
description: Book a rental car reservation

car_id.description: Unique identifier of the rental car listing

payment_method_id.description: ID of the payment method to use

returns: Rental confirmation with reservation_id, car details, pickup instructions, total cost

name: get_flight_status
description: Check the real-time status of a specific flight
returns: Flight status including departure/arrival times, delays, gate information, and terminal

name: compare_flights
description: Compare multiple flights side by side on key attributes

flight_ids.description: List of flight IDs to compare

returns: Side-by-side comparison table of selected flights across specified criteria

name: compare_hotels
description: Compare multiple hotels side by side on key attributes

hotel_ids.description: List of hotel IDs to compare

returns: Side-by-side comparison table of selected hotels across specified criteria

name: get_travel_advisory
description: Get travel advisory and safety information for a destination
returns: Travel advisory level, safety warnings, visa requirements, vaccination requirements, and local emergency contacts

name: search_vacation_packages
description: Search for bundled vacation packages including flights and hotels
returns: List of vacation packages with flight, hotel, total price, and savings compared to booking separately

name: get_visa_requirements
description: Check visa requirements for a specific nationality traveling to a destination
returns: Visa requirements including type, processing time, required documents, and fees

name: search_activities
description: Search for tours, activities, and attractions at a destination

max_price.description: Maximum price per person in USD

returns: List of activities with name, description, price, duration, ratings, and availability

name: book_activity
description: Book a tour or activity at a destination

payment_method_id.description: ID of the payment method to use

returns: Booking confirmation with reservation details, meeting point, and what to bring

name: get_weather_forecast
description: Get weather forecast for a destination on specific dates
returns: Weather forecast with temperature, precipitation, humidity, and clothing recommendations

name: calculate_trip_budget
description: Estimate total trip budget based on destination, duration, and travel style

duration_days.description: Number of days for the trip

origin.description: Origin city for flight cost estimation

returns: Breakdown of estimated costs: flights, accommodation, food, transport, activities, and total

name: get_airport_info
description: Get information about an airport including terminals, lounges, and transport options
returns: Airport details including terminals, lounges, ground transport, restaurants, and tips

name: search_travel_insurance
description: Search for travel insurance plans for a trip
returns: List of insurance plans with coverage details, premium, deductible, and exclusions

name: modify_booking
description: Modify an existing booking (change dates, room type, passenger details, etc.)

booking_id.description: Unique identifier of the booking to modify

changes.description: Object containing fields to change and their new values

returns: Updated booking details with any price difference and modification fee

name: get_currency_exchange_rate
description: Get current currency exchange rates for travel budgeting
returns: Current exchange rate, converted amount, and rate trend over last 30 days

name: create_trip_itinerary
description: Create a day-by-day trip itinerary based on bookings and preferences

booking_ids.description: List of existing booking IDs to include

returns: Day-by-day itinerary with scheduled activities, bookings, transport, and free time

name: search_trains
description: Search for available train routes between two cities
returns: List of available trains with departure/arrival times, duration, price, and class options

name: get_packing_suggestions
description: Get packing suggestions based on destination, weather, and trip type
returns: Categorized packing list with essentials, clothing, electronics, and destination-specific items

name: search_airport_transfers
description: Search for airport transfer options (shuttle, taxi, private car)
returns: List of transfer options with vehicle type, price, estimated duration, and provider

name: list_user_bookings
description: List all bookings for the current user, optionally filtered by status or date range
returns: List of bookings with booking_id, type, status, dates, and summary details

name: add_travel_review
description: Submit a review for a hotel, airline, activity, or car rental

booking_id.description: Booking ID associated with the review

returns: Confirmation of review submission with review ID

name: get_loyalty_program_status
description: Check loyalty program points balance and tier status for airlines or hotels
returns: Points balance, tier status, upcoming tier benefits, and points expiration info

name: set_price_alert
description: Set a price alert for flights or hotels to be notified when prices drop

target_price.description: Target price in USD to trigger alert

returns: Alert confirmation with alert_id and current lowest price
